Let me implement: replace the two REVOKE statements with a DO block that checks for table existence:

```sql
DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='model_permission') THEN
        REVOKE ALL ON model_permission FROM "$QGIS_DB_USER";
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='route_permission') THEN
        REVOKE ALL ON route_permission FROM "$QGIS_DB_USER";
    END IF;
END $$;
```
